import os
os.environ["OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

from PIL import Image, TiffTags
import struct

fn = "/tmp/input_raster.tif"
img = Image.open(fn)
print("Image size (w x h):", img.size)
print("Mode:", img.mode)

# Dump the raw TIFF tags
tags = img.tag_v2
geo = {}
for tag_id, tag in tags.items():
    name = TiffTags.TAGS_V2.get(tag_id, TiffTags.TAGS.get(tag_id, (str(tag_id),)))[0]
    val = tag.value
    if isinstance(val, bytes):
        try:
            val = val.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
        except Exception:
            pass
    if tag_id in (33550, 33922, 34735, 34736, 34737, 42113, 33920, 34264):
        geo[tag_id] = (name, val)
    print(f"[{tag_id}] {name}: {val}")
